propositions: Fourteen call sites hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with repeated mode/output_schema/execution_mode patterns, violating DRY principle and making bounds decisions invisible.
RunRequest's contract requires single_turn requests to carry mode='structured' and output_schema, but nothing enforces this invariant; the constraint is re-asserted by hand at each site.

Only one of the fourteen sites declares lowering-only bounding seams (output_token_limit/structured_retry_limit/transport_attempt_limit/request_timeout_limit_s), making silent omissions indistinguishable from deliberate unbounding and causing bugs like leathery-druidic-nurseshark.
A shared constructor RunRequest.for_structured with required SingleTurnBounds argument will make the bounding decision explicit and greppable at each adoption site.
The adoption requires teaching test_subcall_class_selection.py's AST oracle to recognize RunRequest.for_structured(...) alongside direct RunRequest(...) calls to maintain full site coverage.
